checks: Camp upgrades combine backpack and shared stores, reject incomplete costs without spending, and charge once
HQ restores instantly from its menu or its equipped-hammer action, repairs health and defences once, rejects invalid on-site actions without charging, and retains the first-restoration menu exception
Available catalogue plans precede locked plans, with the familiar starter buildings and equipment first
Journal and tracked HUD resolve the camp upgrade prerequisite before the furnace without granting progress
Camp level automatically unlocks standard plans, without a research payment or recovered-note gate
Furnace repair requires camp access, a held hammer, proximity and full materials; HQ cannot repair it remotely; legacy saves remain valid
Legacy saves keep working facilities and access; malformed blueprint IDs are rejected
Optional tracking, next-step map links and completed objectives persist; malformed journal saves reject
Camp plans and journal tracking survive bunker travel, save reload and returning to camp
Browsing is read-only, previews cannot charge resources, discoveries contain only known events and navigation is voluntary
All headquarters, equipment and discovery illustrations resolve on web and in the offline native bundle
